description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android service called 'RecorderService' and its binder 'RecorderServiceBinder'. The service manages audio recording functionality, including starting, stopping, and initializing audio recordings, as well as tracking recording duration. It uses Android's MediaRecorder API and integrates with Android lifecycle components and Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: RecorderService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService that manages audio recording state and lifecycle, providing binding for external clients.

classes.name: RecorderServiceBinder
classes.description: Binds to the RecorderService and manages the media recorder, including initialization, starting, stopping, and tracking recording duration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the binder when the service is created.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object when the service is bound.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops recording when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: killRecorder
methods.description: Stops and releases the media recorder, optionally stops the service.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops the ongoing recording if active.

methods.name: initializeRecorder
methods.description: Prepares the MediaRecorder with output file and URI, setting audio source and format.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Begins recording and launches a coroutine to track recording time.

methods.name: stopRecordingAndUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds the service connection and stops the recording.
